notes.title: Pinball FX2 VR - 1.0.3 Patch notes
notes.notes:
A new patch went live fixing some environment sound effects and a bunch more minor issues on Steam VR. 

We hope you’ll enjoy the fix and continue to have a great VR experience! 

Patch notes:
- Minor bug fixes.
- Fixed the environment sound volume issue on the Back To The Future table.
